params.rule_applied: Best ceiling across the five registered cells is 0.217, at or below the 0.30 branch boundary. The stability requirement was not reached because no cell cleared the 0.35 bar.
params.summary: Every one of the five never-measured factors scores below both factors already tested. The best of them, trend_consistency_6m at 0.217, does not reach momentum_3m's 0.273, and nothing approaches the 0.30 gate.
params.failed_mechanism: momentum_12m_ex1m was the one cell with a stated mechanism: skipping the most recent month is standard because short-term reversal contaminates raw momentum. It scored 0.080, the worst of the momentum family and below plain momentum_12m at 0.119. The mechanism does not hold on this asset class and the prediction is recorded as wrong.
params.reversal_sign: reversal_1m returns a negative ceiling of -0.106. Per the registration the sign is not flipped and the result is recorded as negative. Its confidence interval spans zero, so it is a weak negative rather than evidence of the opposite effect.
params.p2_factors: The two factors P2 built to attack signal dispersion rather than magnitude, momentum_6m_risk_adj and trend_consistency_6m, are the best of the untested batch at 0.208 and 0.217. They did lower IC standard deviation slightly against momentum_3m, 0.483 and 0.482 against 0.503, but mean IC fell further, 0.076 and 0.079 against 0.107. The design intent was achieved and did not produce a better ratio.
params.post_hoc_observation_not_a_result: Every factor measured scores far higher in the second half of the window than the first: momentum_12m -0.006 to 0.254, momentum_12m_ex1m -0.105 to 0.273, momentum_6m_risk_adj 0.153 to 0.260, trend_consistency_6m 0.105 to 0.345. This pattern was not registered, was noticed only after the split was computed for the stability check, and is recorded here as an observation that could motivate a future registered question about regime dependence. It is not evidence under this registration.
params.conclusion: Three structural levers have now been investigated and all three are dead: universe size in P4, forward horizon in P6, factor choice here. The highest ceiling this project has measured on this asset class remains 0.273, which the feasibility review already showed is indistinguishable from the 0.30 gate and unmeasurable at this sample size.
params.scope_limit: Price-based factors on an eleven-name US ETF layer, twenty-day horizon, one in-sample window. Flow and value factors were excluded because the US panel has no data for them, not because they were tested and failed.
